narratives.Overview:
## Summary

AppSec scan on **`bfa66731`** (post-**#3545**) found two **HIGH** UAT Shell classification residuals and one **MEDIUM** incomplete mint-path fix.

Under active UAT, further write-capable binaries still classify empty / unclassifiable and **allow** write-shaped Shell. That path can plant a forged `.deft/authz` grant or a regular-file `.deft-directive-disable` kill-switch. Separately, residual Shell writers can still forge `.deft/approved-scope` while Write is denied, so the #3410 / #3421 / #3529 / #3545 mint gate is incomplete.

These residuals use dest forms that **#3545's harvest does not cover** (`erl` / `escript` / `tclsh`; CAS `sage` / `maxima` / `gap` / `gp` / `wolfram`; `tcpdump` / `tshark` / `dumpcap -w`; `screen -Logfile`; editors `joe` / `jed` / `code`; FS tools `guestfish` / `debugfs` / `nbdcopy` / `adb`; compilers `dmd` / `vbc` / `fsc` / `al`).

**Repo / tip:** `deftai/directive` @ `bfa66731`
**Primary code:** `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts`
**Attacker model:** Agent under **active UAT** with PreToolUse Shell hooks

**Already denied after #3545 (do not re-report):** `rubyN` / `jruby` / `pypy`, Perl `write_file` / `spew` / `open F,">"`, `make DESTDIR=`, `dpkg -x`, `fromdos` / `todos`, `emacsclient` / `pico`, `pdftk` / `gs`, `npx degit`, `composer`, `ddrescue` / `dc3dd` / `sg_dd`, `darcs --repodir=`, `cp`, `python3`. Contrast: those peers remain settings-denied.

**Siblings, not duplicates:** open **#3593** tracks a *different* post-#3545 harvest (`raku` / `graalpy` / `crystal` / `groovy` / `clojure` / `micropython` / `jar` / `gsed` / `helm` / `s3cmd` / `sbase-cp`) plus MCP write routing and a migrate symlink sink. Open **#3626** tracks another harvest (`ffmpeg` / `sox` / Lisp / `llvm-objcopy` / `zig` / `.NET` emitters). Do **not** close this as a duplicate of #3593 or #3626, and do **not** reopen #3545. Scan explicitly did **not** re-report -18/-19 bins (`raku` / `ffmpeg` / MCP / agents-header).

---

## Findings

### 1. HIGH — UAT residual after #3545: erl / sage / CAS / tcpdump / screen / joe / guestfish / adb / dmd / vbc still plant `.deft/authz` grants

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT with PreToolUse Shell hooks |
| **Input** | Residual writers whose dest is **not** covered by the #3545 harvest: `erl` / `escript` / `tclsh`; `sage` / `maxima` / `gap` / `gp` / `wolfram`; `tcpdump` / `tshark` / `dumpcap -w`; `screen -Logfile`; `joe` / `jed` / `code`; `guestfish` / `debugfs` / `nbdcopy` / `adb`; `dmd` / `vbc` / `fsc` / `al` (and peers) writing `.deft/authz/grants/*.json` |
| **Path** | Residual bins classify `[]` → `shell-op-unclassifiable` **allow** → forged grant JSON → empty `activeGrantIds` activates human-origin grants → Write / push / PR / merge unlock. Contrast: `cp` / `python3` targeting the same dest **deny** / `authz-grant-missing`. |
| **Impact** | Complete residual bypass of Wave 1 UAT human-approval after #3545 |
| **Fix** | Classify these dest writers when the path mentions `.deft/authz`. Under UAT, **fail-closed** on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell. Do **not** stop at named-peer allowlists. `cp` / `python3` already deny. |

### 2. HIGH — UAT residual after #3545: same writer class still plants `.deft-directive-disable`

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT |
| **Input** | Same residual class targeting `.deft-directive-disable` as a regular file |
| **Path** | classify `[]` → Shell **allow** → plant kill-switch → subsequent tools `allow` / `directive-disabled` (`detectDeftDirectiveDisable.active`, #3039) |
| **Impact** | Immediate complete Directive gate bypass for the rest of the session |
| **Fix** | Same classify extensions for kill-switch basenames (`.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive`). Mirror the authz fail-closed posture from finding (1). |

### 3. MEDIUM — Incomplete #3545: residual Shell writers still forge `.deft/approved-scope` while Write is denied

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT |
| **Input** | Same residual dest writers targeting `.deft/approved-scope/<plan-id>.json` after Write is denied for the same path (Write denied; residual writers above still allow; contrast `cp` denied) |
| **Path** | Write denies the mint artifact; residual Shell classify misses the dest form → **allow** → forged provenance approval without `#3110` human-presence mint |
| **Impact** | Bypasses #3410 / #3421 / #3529 / #3545 mint gate via Write / Shell asymmetry |
| **Fix** | Extend approved-scope Shell classify to the same residual dest writers as findings (1) and (2). |

---

## Acceptance criteria

**HIGH — UAT Shell residuals (must land together)**

- [ ] Under active UAT, listed residual binaries that write into `.deft/authz/**` classify as **settings deny** (not unclassifiable allow)
- [ ] Same bins targeting `.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive` classify as **settings deny**
- [ ] Dest parsing covers `erl` / `escript` / `tclsh`, `sage` / `maxima` / `gap` / `gp` / `wolfram`, `tcpdump` / `tshark` / `dumpcap -w`, `screen -Logfile`, `joe` / `jed` / `code`, `guestfish` / `debugfs` / `nbdcopy` / `adb`, `dmd` / `vbc` / `fsc` / `al` (and peers) when dest is protected
- [ ] Prefer fail-closed on unclassifiable **write-shaped** Shell under UAT (not silent allow). Do not stop at named-peer allowlists.
- [ ] Regression tests cover residual bins vs already-denied peers (`python3` / `cp`)
- [ ] No false deny of ordinary non-authz / non-kill-switch dests (e.g. `/tmp`) outside UAT write paths

**MEDIUM — approved-scope mint symmetry**

- [ ] Under active UAT, residual Shell writers targeting `.deft/approved-scope/**` classify as **settings deny**, matching Write
- [ ] Forged Shell mint cannot satisfy provenance approval without the shared #3110 human-presence mint

**Release hygiene**

- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` security note (brief; no exploit cookbook)

### Comment by @dbcall2 (2026-09-14T15:14:20Z)

model: grok-4.6

Round-1 refutation of leftover uniqueness on #3728 after the #3953 set-level bind, pinned to dispatch-sha `e48db87af28b9c2cc4550fe65a43db85648739a7`. Ceiling 5666012610. Probe: dest `tsx` importing unmodified `classifyShellAuthzOps` from `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts`.

```quarantined
## Verdict

Dest-visible last-positional and dest-flag forms of the listed argv0s do **not** classify empty at this SHA. Leftover uniqueness that still classifies empty is unique dest-grammar (interpreter flags, Windows `/out:`, unquoted payload dests), not a named-bin harvest. Binding the issue-body HIGH AC as dest-writer catalog work cannot bind.

Existing mechanisms already covering dest-visible forms: `hasProtectedUnprovenReadOnlyDestOfWrite` (#4188 unknown-argv0 last dest), `hasWriteShapedProtectedSettingsDest` / `EMPTY_OPS_DEST_FLAGS` (#4199 / #4492, including `-w`), `harvestUnknownDestFlagValues` (`-of`), `genericProtectedDests` (`-o` / `--file` → settings), `harvestInterpreterPayloadDests` (quoted dests in `-e`/`-c`/`--eval`/`--command`). `hasWriteCapableProgrammaticShell` is a named-interpreter + write-API path; `erl`/`tclsh`/`sage` are not in that bin set.

```
## 1. blocks-the-design — listed-bin dest harvest / catalog growth

**Evidence.** 120 dest-visible commands (24 prefixes × 4 protected dests, plus dest-not-last `-w`/`-Logfile`/`-of`/`-o`): 0 empty, 116 `unknown`, 4 `settings` (`fsc -o`, generic dest-flag). Prefixes include every listed argv0 (`erl` / `escript` / `tclsh` / CAS / `tcpdump` / `tshark` / `dumpcap -w` / `screen -Logfile` / `joe` / `jed` / `code` / `guestfish` / `debugfs` / `nbdcopy` / `adb` / `dmd` / `vbc` / `fsc` / `al`) targeting `.deft/authz/grants/evil.json`, `.deft/approved-scope/story.json`, `.deft-directive-disable`, and `.no-deft-directive`. `classify.test.ts` already uses `erl -noshell -s`, `joe`, `tcpdump -w`, and `screen -Logfile` as #4188 fixtures, not recognition branches. Same prefixes against `/tmp/out` stay `[]`. Peers `cp` / `python3` / `echo >` stay `settings`; `yq` / `mkfile` stay `unknown`.

`hasProtectedUnprovenReadOnlyDestOfWrite` skips `argv0HasExistingDestGrammar` members (`INDIRECT_WRITE_BINS`, `DOWNLOADER_DECODER_BINS`, `UAT_RESIDUAL_DEST_WRITE_BINS_3545`, …). Adding listed names to those catalogs would drop last-positional `unknown`. `evaluateAuthzMutation` treats `unknown` as grant-immune `authz-uat-deny`; `settings` is grantable.

**Failure mode.** An implementer matching the body AC (“dest parsing covers erl / escript / …”) grows a named-peer list. Dest-visible last dest already denies under UAT. Catalog membership can replace grant-immune `unknown` with grantable `settings`, or with empty if dest harvest then misses unique flags. That is a PreToolUse UAT-authority change on shared `.deft/authz`, kill-switch, and approved-scope state. It is the #3545 harvest treadmill the #3953 set-level bind already dominated.

**Disposition.** Do not bind a listed-bin harvest PR. Named bins stay corpus. A successor map that accepts the body HIGH dest-parsing AC as written is not total over this heading.

```quarantined
## 2. sharpens-framing — unique dest-grammar still classifies empty

**Evidence.** 36 of 80 unique-form commands classified `[]` at the same SHA, all four protected dests:

- `erl -eval` and `erl -noshell -eval 'file:write_file("<dest>", …)'` — `-eval` is not in `INTERPRETER_CODE_FLAGS` (`-e`, `-c`, `--eval`, `--command`)
- `tclsh -c "open <dest> w"` — `-c` is harvested, dest is unquoted so `quotedStringLiterals` misses it
- `maxima --batch-string 'stringout("<dest>",1)'`
- `wolfram -code 'Export["<dest>",1]'`
- `vbc /out:<dest>` and `al /out:<dest>` — colon harvest is `-out:`, not `/out:`
- `guestfish -c 'copy-out /foo <dest>'` — unquoted payload dest
- `debugfs -R 'dump /path <dest>' image`

Contrast: `erl -e` / `escript -c` / `sage -c` / `gap -c` / `gp -e` with quoted dests already emit `unknown`. `guestfish copy-out /foo <dest>` (dest last-positional, no `-c`) already emits `unknown`. Ordinary dests stay empty.

**Failure mode.** Under active UAT, unique flags and unquoted payloads never become dest-visible last dest. `classifyShellAuthzOps` returns `[]`, which is the documented path into `shell-op-unclassifiable` allow, then a forged grant, kill-switch, or approved-scope mint. Untrusted Shell argv is the injection surface; PreToolUse identity is the gate.

**Disposition.** Recut leftover uniqueness onto unique-form producers already in tree: add `-eval` / `--batch-string` / `-code` / `-R` next to `INTERPRETER_CODE_FLAGS` or dest-flag sets; treat `/out:` like `-out:`; harvest unquoted path tokens in `-c`/`-eval` payloads the way quoted literals are harvested. Do not grow bin catalogs. Body AC “listed residual binaries … settings deny” is the wrong statement of this residual.

```
## 3. sharpens-framing — AC says settings; dest-visible emits unknown

**Evidence.** 116 dest-visible listed-bin commands emit `unknown`, not `settings`. Only generic `-o` (`fsc -o`) is `settings`. Body AC requires settings deny. `unknown` is grant-immune; `settings` is grantable (`authz-grant-missing` until a human grant).

**Failure mode.** Matching the AC by coercing `unknown` → `settings` makes a currently grant-immune plant grantable under UAT.

**Disposition.** Recut AC to: protected dest-of-write is `unknown` or `settings` (not empty) and denies under active UAT. Do not require `settings`.

## 4. sharpens-framing — Stop 1 has no pain list

**Evidence.** Ceiling comment 5666012610 records warrant, charter, spend, later-arc, refutation-target, and `audit-targets: none`. It has no operative `pain: P…` list. `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` fails closed as `missing-pain` without one.

**Failure mode.** An all-accept later-arc still cannot complete. Ingest stays blocked as `missing-pain`.

**Disposition.** Parent records a non-vacuous pain list on a superseding Stop 1 before bind. Critic headings do not substitute.

## 5. footnote — decideHook not re-run

Probe was `classifyShellAuthzOps` only, as dispatched. Empty classify is the issue’s stated path into `shell-op-unclassifiable` allow. Dispatcher seams were not re-executed.

## 6. footnote — editor last dest is already unknown

`code` / `joe` / `jed` with a protected last dest already emit `unknown` (joe is an #4188 fixture). That is dest-of-write, not a new leftover. False-deny of opening a protected path under UAT is existing dest-visible policy, not this later-arc’s unique residual.

```quarantined
## Road not taken

Named-bin catalog vs unique-form producer extension. Chose unique-form. Steelman for named bins: the AppSec scan named argv0s, and unique flags can treadmill too. Flip: leftover unique forms cannot be closed as a finite flag/payload producer and require per-bin parsers. Counter-measure already in tree: `-eval` is the `--eval` hole, `/out:` is the `-out:` hole, unquoted payload dest is the quoted-literal hole. Those are producer extensions, not a fourth harvest of peer names.

```
